blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) has issued 372 special permits to passenger buses to accommodate the expected increase in travelers during the five-day Asean holiday break. The board said on Friday that the additional buses would help meet passenger demand as workers and students take advantage of the break to travel to their home provinces. The 49th Asean Summit and related meetings will be held from Nov. 16 to 18. Malacañang earlier declared these dates as special non-working days in Metro Manila, giving residents a five-day break.
